faq.q: What does the Risk Assessment course cover?
faq.a: This course provides restoration and cleaning professionals with a complete, practical risk assessment framework — from understanding Australian WHS law to building and using a risk matrix, completing a JSEA, writing a SWMS, and conducting genuine consultation with workers.
